# React Immersive

> @liveroom-tech/react-immersive@5.2.0: interactive 3D viewers and scene authoring for React 19.

Official package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liveroom-tech/react-immersive
Public source: https://github.com/Liveroom-Technologies/react-immersive-docs
Compatibility: React/React DOM ^19.0.0; Three.js ^0.184.0; React Three Fiber ^9.6.1.

Start with SimpleModelViewer from /simple-model-viewer, its simple-model-viewer.css stylesheet, a public model URL and a container with explicit height. ModelViewer is imported from the main entry; BindingBuilder from /binding-builder. Both need a runtime licenseKey. SimpleModelViewer has no key prop and needs no key or paid plan, including in production.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/agent-guide.md): component choice, first render, APIs and validation.
- [Vite setup](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/frameworks/vite.md): complete React 19 files.
- [Next.js setup](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/frameworks/nextjs.md): App Router, CSS and client boundary.
- [Getting started](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/getting-started.md): bindings and mutable state.
- [Licensing](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/licensing.md): local vs production, manual account/key steps.
- [Troubleshooting](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/troubleshooting.md): imports, types, assets, CORS and rendering.
- [Versions and migration](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/releases.md): supported baseline and upgrading starters.
- [Manifest](https://react-immersive.liveroom.dev/docs/manifest.json): exact version, peers, all page URLs and small ModelViewer section URLs.
